name: Virginia
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A state whose hot, humid summers challenge growers, and whose industry only grew past novelty status in the last twenty years. Chardonnay, Cabernet Franc and Merlot are the most planted grapes, mostly in central and northern Virginia.
